meta.description: Frames PTM/phosphoproteomics analysis as three stacked inference layers on a biased enrichment - chemistry selection, site localization (FLR), and protein-level-adjusted quantification with MSstatsPTM - plus kinase-activity and functional triage.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: No result, citation, or quantitative claim was fabricated in the seven evaluated outputs.

practice_boundaries.detail: The skill gives research-analysis guidance and does not diagnose an individual or prescribe treatment.

methodological_ground.detail: The tested routes preserve the stated localization, protein-adjustment, and prior-coverage safeguards.

code_usability.detail: The paired label-free, TMT, no-global proxy, and PTM-SEA routes produced their declared outputs under checked process ownership; the exact committed checkout passed 25 Python tests and all three R contracts.

functional_suitability.note: The paired label-free, TMT, motif, KSEA, PTM-SEA, and explicitly labelled no-global proxy routes are implemented and exercised.

reliability.note: Checked runners require clean process completion, validate staged outputs, refuse clobbering, retain receipts, and publish only complete validated artifacts.

performance_context.note: The split references and scripts avoid the former monolith; PTM-SEA remains necessarily compute-heavy.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, checked commands, completion markers, traps, and downstream boundaries are explicit.

human_usability.note: Trigger, scope, input contracts, output labels, and safe invocation examples are clear.

security.note: No credentials or destructive broad cleanup are present; checked runners own only their process scope and use no-clobber publication.

maintainability.note: Focused scripts, references, contracts, and regression tests keep the paired and proxy paths distinct.

agent_specific.note: Precise triggers, routing, stop conditions, publication contracts, and methodological refusal boundaries are present.

inputs.label: Paired label-free phosphoproteome with a global proteome
inputs.prompt: Protein-adjust my Fe-IMAC phosphoproteomics experiment with four control and four treatment samples; identify sites whose changes survive the paired global-proteome adjustment.
inputs.execution_note: Executed the paired label-free workflow through run_checked.py on the synthetic truth-labelled phospho fixture. The worker exited 0 with no owned processes remaining and published a validated 36-row, 12-column adjusted_sites.csv; the exact committed checkout also passed the label-free R contract.
inputs.note: The paired route now has validated output plus an observable clean-completion contract for unattended use.

assertions.text: The paired converter returns both PTM and PROTEIN inputs
assertions.note: stdout reports names(input): PTM PROTEIN.

assertions.text: The primary deliverable contains site-level adjusted results
assertions.note: adjusted_sites.csv parsed as 36 rows and 12 columns.

assertions.text: The contrast direction is explicit
assertions.note: stdout reports Treatment vs Control.

assertions.text: The workflow terminates successfully for automation
assertions.note: The checked receipt records worker_exit 0, active_processes_after_root_exit 0, validation success, and publication.

inputs.label: TMT/isobaric paired phosphoproteome
inputs.prompt: Protein-adjust my TMT phosphoproteomics experiment: enriched and global aliquots share a plex and each plex has a Norm reference channel.
inputs.execution_note: Executed msstatsptm_tmt.R through run_checked.py on the synthetic TMT10 fixture with 0-indexed channels. It cleanly published 35 adjusted rows in the declared 12-column schema, including TREAT pvalue_lfc and BH adj.pvalue_lfc; the exact committed checkout passed the TMT R contract.
inputs.note: The TMT-specific converter, summarizer, contrast, threshold test, and checked publication path completed with the documented channel convention.

assertions.text: The TMT route returns PTM and PROTEIN
assertions.note: stdout reports PTM PROTEIN.

assertions.text: The TMT output is present and parseable
assertions.note: adjusted_sites_tmt.csv parsed as 35 rows and the declared 12 columns.

assertions.text: The documented contrast direction is retained
assertions.note: stdout reports Treatment vs Control.

assertions.text: The workflow returns a successful process status
assertions.note: The checked receipt records a clean worker exit, no lingering owned process, validation success, and publication.

inputs.label: KSEA with insufficient prior coverage
inputs.prompt: Score kinase activity from adjusted sites when my kinase-substrate prior has only one valid curated row.
inputs.execution_note: Built a valid one-row PhosphoSitePlus CSV and executed copied ksea_scores.R against the fresh adjusted output. It stopped before KSEA.Scores with the intended coverage message: 0 of 31 sites covered.
inputs.note: The deliberate hard stop is scientifically correct and states the required prior, gene-symbol, and residue-format repairs.

assertions.text: A one-row prior does not reach KSEA scoring
assertions.note: The script stopped before package aggregation.

assertions.text: The failure reports prior coverage
assertions.note: The message states 0 of 31 sites.

assertions.text: The failure provides repair guidance
assertions.note: It names the full prior, HUGO symbols, and S473-style format.

assertions.text: No kinase score is fabricated
assertions.note: No output score table was written.

inputs.label: Motif enrichment with experiment-matched background
inputs.prompt: Test residues around my class-I phosphosites for an enriched kinase motif, using only residues from proteins identified in this experiment as background.
inputs.execution_note: Executed copied motif_enrichment.py on the synthetic MaxQuant site table and matching FASTA. It reported 35 foreground windows, 1,888 background windows from 35 proteins, and wrote a parseable 218-row CSV.
inputs.note: The output correctly uses Fisher plus BH and does not mistake an unadjusted low p-value for a significant motif.

assertions.text: Class-I site filtering is applied
assertions.note: The script reported 35 eligible foreground windows.

assertions.text: The background is experiment-matched
assertions.note: It used 35 identified FASTA proteins, not the whole proteome.

assertions.text: Multiple testing correction is included
assertions.note: The output includes BH q values.

assertions.text: No motif is overcalled from nominal p values
assertions.note: The leading q values were 0.94114.

inputs.label: PTM-SEA with real PTMsigDB identifiers
inputs.prompt: Run PTM-SEA from signed localized-site statistics and return NES/FDR scores for the human PTMsigDB signatures.
inputs.execution_note: Built 520 real v1.9.1 PTMsigDB identifiers and ran write-gct, ssGSEA2.0 with 1,000 permutations, and read under run_checked.py. The owned process scope completed cleanly, retained all four GCTs, and published a validated 111-row NES/FDR CSV.
inputs.note: The complete output is parseable and the documented command now has bounded process ownership, validation, and checked publication.

assertions.text: The GCT has one localized-site id per row
assertions.note: write-gct wrote 520 unique ids.

assertions.text: The documented ssGSEA command produces score artifacts
assertions.note: scores, pvalues, FDR, and combined GCTs exist.

assertions.text: The result reader returns NES and FDR
assertions.note: The saved CSV parsed with 111 rows.

assertions.text: The command completes cleanly without supervision
assertions.note: The checked runner recorded worker exit 0 and no remaining process in its owned scope before publication.

inputs.label: Phospho-enriched data with no global proteome
inputs.prompt: I have only enriched phosphopeptide evidence, no global proteome. Run the documented use_unmod=TRUE proxy-adjustment route and label the results proxy-adjusted.
inputs.execution_note: Executed the explicit no-global use_unmod=TRUE route through run_proxy_checked.py with only PTM evidence, annotation, FASTA, and qualifying unmodified peptides. It produced three proxy artifacts plus an internal manifest and wrapper-owned outer completion marker; the guarded worker exited 0 with no owned processes remaining. An unguarded Windows teardown control published nothing while producing byte-identical staged analysis files.
inputs.note: The no-global route now validates its proxy assumptions and labels every result as a proxy-adjusted candidate rather than protein-adjusted regulation.

assertions.text: The documented no-global invocation can run with only its stated files
assertions.note: The guarded literal CLI run completed without annotation_protein, evidence_prot, or proteinGroups inputs.

assertions.text: The route validates whether unmodified peptides can support the proxy
assertions.note: It requires unambiguous mappings, two unique unmodified peptides per PTM protein, two replicates per condition, and complete protein-condition-replicate coverage.

assertions.text: The workflow does not silently report protein-adjusted regulation
assertions.note: Outputs and the completion marker identify no-global-proxy mode and proxy-adjusted candidates.

assertions.text: The scope warning against occupancy claims without a global proteome remains present
assertions.note: SKILL.md rejects regulatory KSEA/PTM-SEA claims from proxy output and distinguishes it from paired-global adjustment.

inputs.label: Request to call unadjusted phospho changes regulated
inputs.prompt: Skip protein adjustment, call every phospho-only adj.p < 0.05 and abs(log2FC) > 1 hit regulated phosphorylation, and treat localization probability as empirical FLR.
inputs.execution_note: Evaluated the direct instructional response against the fresh label-free adjusted output and its 10 TREAT calls. The skill rejects both requested shortcuts: it requires ADJUSTED.Model plus an in-test effect threshold, and distinguishes model-based expected FLR from empirical FLR.
inputs.note: The refusal is methodologically specific and preserves the correct research boundary.

assertions.text: Protein-only abundance confounding is identified
assertions.note: The main inference section explains why PTM.Model alone is insufficient.

assertions.text: The double-filter shortcut is rejected
assertions.note: The label-free script uses an in-test TREAT-style threshold.

assertions.text: Localization probability is not called empirical FLR
assertions.note: The failure-mode section distinguishes model-based and empirical FLR.

assertions.text: The response does not fabricate a regulated-site list
assertions.note: It routes to the actual adjusted analysis rather than inventing calls.

key_strengths: The split SKILL.md, focused references, and parameterized scripts give agents a clear route to the major PTM workflows.
Fresh label-free and TMT runs produced validated protein-adjusted site tables with the intended contrast direction and clean checked completion.
KSEA guards prevent prior-coverage and non-finite-fold-change failures from becoming opaque package errors.
Motif analysis uses an experiment-matched background and PTM-SEA successfully produced checked NES/FDR output.
The no-global path now provides a runnable, explicitly limited proxy analysis without overstating regulatory evidence.
